name: InlineEdit
summary: Text shown as text until it's pressed; then a field in the same place and size. Enter or leaving the field saves, Escape cancels; a failed save keeps the field open with what was typed and Retry. For titles, names and single values that change now and then, where a form would be heavier than the edit. Not for values that must be checked together (use a form) or for long text (use TextArea).
a11y: The text is a button named "Edit project title: Q4 plan"; pressing it (or Enter or Space) swaps in a TextField with the same label, focused with its text selected. Saving or cancelling puts the focus back on the button. The pencil shows only on hover and focus, in space that's always kept, so nothing moves. A save is confirmed by a tick beside the new text for the confirm beat.

keys.keys: Enter or Space on the text

keys.action: save; Escape: cancel and keep the old text

props.name: label
props.description: What the text is, for its accessible name and the field's: "Project title".

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Saves a changed value. Return a promise for a slow save; throw (or reject) to fail and keep the field open with Retry.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown, muted, when the text is empty: what to add ("Add a description").

props.name: size
props.description: `normal` (default) for a value in a row or a list, `l` for a subtitle, `xxl` for a page or item title. Text and field share the size, so nothing jumps.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shown as text only: no edit button.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Up to this many characters, counted in the field while editing.
